rules: A selected goal can prioritize supplement rule groups but cannot add recommendation points by itself unless a future evidence-backed rule explicitly justifies that use.
A selected goal can request additional relevant questions.
Marketing entry points can preselect goals/situations but cannot preselect supplements.
The engine must be able to return 'no clear supplement indication' for any goal.
Safety blocks always override goal prioritization.
PRO AI may use goals to decide what to ask next, but recommendations must still cite evidence-backed claims.
marketing_guardrail: Prefer language such as 'descubrí qué conviene revisar' or 'qué tiene evidencia para tu perfil' instead of 'los mejores suplementos para X'.
